{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Charles Dean O'Banion (July 8, 1892 – November 10, 1924) was an American mobster who was the main rival of Johnny Torrio and Al Capone during the brutal Chicago bootlegging wars of the 1920s.","title":"Dean O'Banion"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" The newspapers of his day made him better known as Dion O'Banion, although he never went by that first name.","title":"Dean O'Banion"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" He led the North Side Gang until 1924, when he was murdered, reportedly by Frankie Yale, John Scalise and Albert Anselmi.","title":"Dean O'Banion"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Angelo \"Bloody Angelo\" Genna (February 3, 1898 – May 26, 1925) was a Chicago bootlegger and organized crime leader during the Prohibition era.","title":"Angelo Genna"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" The leader of his own Sicilian crime family, he was best known for his war with the North Side Gang leader, Charles Dean O'Banion.","title":"Angelo Genna"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" Genna masterminded the assassination of O'Banion in November 1924.","title":"Angelo Genna"}],"peer_messages":["Unverified peer answer: Al Capone\nEvidence: {\"sentence_id\":0,\"text\":\"Vincent Drucci, also known as \\\"The Schemer\\\" (born Vincenzo D'Ambrosio; 1898 – April 4, 1927), was an Sicilian-American mobster during Chicago's Prohibition era who was a member of the North Side Gang, Al Capone's best known rivals.\",\"title\":\"Vincent Drucci\"}","Unverified peer answer: noanswer"],"previous_answer":"Al Capone","question":"Dean O'Banion was the main rival of which mobster, known as Scarface?"}
